description: React component for managing channel details in Mattermost admin console, including access control, group management, permissions, and channel policies.

classes.name: ChannelDetails
classes.description: React component for managing detailed settings of a specific channel, including permissions, group associations, access policies, and channel-specific rules.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates when component receives new props, including loading user attributes, policies, and channel rules if needed.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial data loading when component mounts, including channel info, permissions, policies, and related data.

methods.name: restrictChannelMentions
methods.description: Adjusts channel permissions to disable channel mentions based on roles and create_post permission.

methods.name: setToggles
methods.description: Sets toggle states for channel sync, privacy, and policy enforcement, and triggers group processing.

methods.name: processGroupsChange
methods.description: Handles changes to channel groups, including server updates and error handling.

methods.name: handleGroupRemoved
methods.description: Removes a group from the state and updates server accordingly.

methods.name: setNewGroupRole
methods.description: Toggles scheme admin role for a specific group.

methods.name: channelPermissionsChanged
methods.description: Updates permissions roles for a specific permission and role, with special handling for create_post and use_channel_mentions.

methods.name: handleGroupChange
methods.description: Adds new groups to the current list and processes changes.

methods.name: hideConvertConfirmModal
methods.description: Hides the convert confirmation modal.

methods.name: hideRemoveConfirmModal
methods.description: Hides the remove confirmation modal.

methods.name: hideConvertAndRemoveConfirmModal
methods.description: Hides the convert and remove confirmation modal.

methods.name: hideArchiveConfirmModal
methods.description: Hides the archive confirmation modal.

methods.name: hideAccessRulesConfirmModal
methods.description: Hides the access rules confirmation modal and resets related state.

methods.name: confirmAccessRulesSave
methods.description: Confirms and proceeds with saving access rules after user approval.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Main save handler that determines what actions to perform based on current state, including archiving, privacy, and policy updates.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Performs the actual save operation, including updating channel privacy, group associations, permissions, and access policies, with error handling.

methods.name: channelToBeArchived
methods.description: Determines if the channel is marked for archiving based on local and server state.

methods.name: channelToBeRestored
methods.description: Determines if the channel is marked for restoration based on local and server state.

methods.name: addRolesToUpdate
methods.description: Adds or updates user roles (schemeUser, schemeAdmin) for a specific user in the component state.

methods.name: addUserToRemove
methods.description: Marks a user for removal from the channel, updating counts and state accordingly.

methods.name: addUsersToAdd
methods.description: Adds multiple users to the channel, updating state and counts.

methods.name: onToggleArchive
methods.description: Toggles the local archived state of the channel, managing server errors and UI state.

methods.name: onPolicySelected
methods.description: Adds a selected access control policy to the list of policies for the channel.

methods.name: onPolicyRemoveAll
methods.description: Removes all access control policies from the channel.

methods.name: onPolicyRemove
methods.description: Removes a specific access control policy by ID.

methods.name: handleChannelRulesChange
methods.description: Updates channel rules expression and auto-sync status, toggling policy enforcement.

methods.name: loadUserAttributes
methods.description: Loads user attributes for access control from API, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: loadChannelLevelAccessRules
methods.description: Loads channel-specific access policy rules and updates state.

methods.name: combineParentAndChannelExpressions
methods.description: Combines parent policy expressions with channel expression using AND logic.

methods.name: calculateMembershipChanges
methods.description: Calculates which users to add or remove based on combined access rules and current channel members.

methods.name: fetchAccessControlPolicies
methods.description: Fetches access control policies and their imports for a given channel.
